name: SSC (Staff Selection Commission) — Apply
instructions: One-time registration (OTR) on ssc.gov.in, then each exam (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD, Steno…) is applied from your dashboard. Registration has two parts (basic details, then photo/signature/more); login takes your registration number, password and a captcha. Fills from your profile first (no AI for known questions), asks you only for codes (OTP), passwords, captchas and anything new, pauses for your review, then submits. For Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification it asks you for the number, consent and OTP/PIN in chat and types them in (never saved). Payments are always done by you.

starterActionPlan.description: Register or sign in: fills your details, asks for OTP, password and captcha
Fill every page of the application (details, education, photo, signature, declaration)
